name: ETSY_KEYSTRING
label: Etsy app API key (keystring)
setupSteps: In the Etsy Developers portal, open your app and copy its keystring (API key).
This value is sent as the `x-api-key` header and used as the OAuth client id (PKCE public client).
Set the app's OAuth callback / redirect URI to the redirect URI below.

name: ETSY_SHARED_SECRET
label: Etsy shared secret
setupSteps: Copy the shared secret from the same Etsy app.
Not required by the v3 PKCE public-client flow; stored for completeness / future use.
